newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Glorious Sun IPO over 30 times subscribed - sources.
newsitem.headline: Glorious Sun IPO over 30 times subscribed - sources.

text.p: The initial public offering of casual wear maker and retailer Glorious Sun Enterprises Ltd has been over 30 times subscribed since it opened on Thursday, market sources said.
The offer will close on Tuesday.
The sources said the grey market price ranged from HK$1.92 to HK$2.00 per share late Friday afternoon.
Analysts generally expect the new issue to be over 50 times subscribed.
Dealing in the shares is expected to begin on September 17.
HSBC Investment Bank Asia Ltd is the global coordinater.

Glorious Sun has offered 250 million new shares total, comprising a retail offer of 100 million and a placement of 150 million, in both cases at HK$1.60 per share. It said it would reallocate 25 million shares to the retail offering if that portion was over three times subscribed.
The company said proceeds would be used to further develop and expand its Jeanswest retail network in China, Australia and New Zealand.
It also makes jeans for retailers including The Gap, JC Penney and Haggar.
